system.description: When the Beast succeeds with a melee attack using its Natural Weapons and the attack deals damage greater than the target's Damage Threshold, the target takes an additional 5 points of damage and moves -1 step on the Condition Track. Targets with the Arctic Species Type are immune to this Special Quality.
